pendulum.mcp.tool.eval: Execute JavaScript code in Minecraft. Key globals: mc/minecraft/game. API: mc.player.* (movement, rotation, interaction, state), mc.world.* (blocks, entities, environment), mc.inv.* (inventory, container), mc.gui.* (screen click, type, enumerate widgets). All functions are synchronous. BARITONE: if installed, prefer br.* (br.goto, br.mine, br.follow, br.stop, br.isActive, br.command).
pendulum.mcp.tool.eval.param.code: JS code. E.g.: mc.player.forward(20); for(let b of mc.world.findBlocks('diamond_ore',16)) mc.player.breakBlockAt(b.x,b.y,b.z); JSON.stringify(mc.inv.getAllItems()); mc.world.rayTrace(5). If baritone: br.goto(100,64,200); br.mine('diamond_ore',64);
pendulum.mcp.tool.eval_async: Execute JavaScript asynchronously — returns immediately. Use 'status' to check completion. For scripts longer than 120s.
pendulum.mcp.tool.status: Check if a script is currently running.
pendulum.mcp.tool.health: Health check: reports screenshot capability, keyboard injection, Baritone availability, and script state.
pendulum.mcp.tool.screenshot: Capture a screenshot with coordinate grid overlay. Returns base64 PNG. Use optional 'path' to also save to disk.
pendulum.mcp.tool.screenshot.param.path: File path to save. Omit for base64 return only.
pendulum.mcp.tool.click: Click at screen coordinates. Use after 'screenshot' to target UI elements. Screenshot includes a coordinate grid.
pendulum.mcp.tool.click_button: Find a button/widget by text substring or type name and click its center. Searches recursively. Returns widget info.
pendulum.mcp.tool.click_button.param.tar: Text to match (substring, case-insensitive) or widget type name.
pendulum.mcp.tool.enumerate_widgets: Recursively enumerate ALL GUI widgets including nested children. Returns [{type, text?, x, y, width, height, active?, focused?, children?}, ...].
pendulum.mcp.tool.gui_elements: Get flat list of non-slot GUI elements (buttons, labels). Returns [{type, x, y, width, height, text?}].
pendulum.mcp.tool.press_key: Press a keyboard key. Supports: W, Enter, ESC, SPACE, F3, A, etc. Can hold for N seconds.
pendulum.mcp.tool.press_key.param.hold: Duration to hold in seconds. Default 0 (press and release).
pendulum.mcp.tool.type_text: Type text into the focused text field character by character.
pendulum.mcp.tool.type_text.param.enter: Press Enter after typing. Default false.
pendulum.mcp.tool.paste_text: Type text quickly (same as typeText, for large blocks).
pendulum.mcp.tool.scroll: Scroll mouse wheel. Positive = up, negative = down.
pendulum.mcp.tool.hotkey: Press a key combination. E.g. 'ctrl,s' or 'shift,f3'.
pendulum.mcp.tool.mouse_drag: Drag mouse from one point to another.
pendulum.mcp.tool.call_screen_method: DANGEROUS — Call an arbitrary no-arg method on the current GUI screen via reflection. All exceptions caught.
pendulum.mcp.tool.call_screen_method.par: Method name to call on the screen object.
pendulum.mcp.tool.select_list_item: Select an item from a dropdown/list widget by text substring (case-insensitive).
pendulum.mcp.tool.wait: Wait for N seconds. Useful for sequencing actions.
pendulum.mcp.tool.video_start: EXPERIMENTAL — Start ~10fps video capture. Reads GPU every 6 frames — expensive. Prefer 'screenshot' for single shots.
pendulum.mcp.tool.video_frame: Get latest cached video frame as base64 PNG. Error if no recent frame (< 5s).
